name: angel lover
source:
i found it motionless on the river bank, a few miles down from the bridge. it jumped, of course, i thought, before it occurred to me that an angel wouldn't likely kill itself in such a way. it had wings. what would be the point?

umbra finds a dead angel by the river. but not even death can stop a true lover.


[From [url=https://jammyjams.itch.io/angel-lover]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我在大桥下游几英里处的河岸边发现了它，一动不动地躺在那里。起初我理所当然地以为它是跳桥自尽的，转念一想才回过味来——天使怎么可能用这种方式寻死呢？它明明长着翅膀，跳桥又有什么意义？

安布拉在河畔捡到了一具天使的遗体。然而，哪怕是死亡也无法阻挡一位真正的爱人。


[摘自[url=https://jammyjams.itch.io/angel-lover]itch.io[/url]]
